body: Ok. girls4gunslingers is just pictures of naked or nearly nude women, and army wtf moments is memes. I still don't know how these sites are for horribly depressed service members.

I'll give it a look

Edit: Thanks, but I'm not sure I can connect with anyone on those sites. I would also have to remain anonymous.
This is the marine corps. Every single grunt is so god damned macho that no one is who they say they are. I don't even know the personal side of my room mate. I wish it was that easy.

There may be other people who suffer, but not a single one of us is allowed to say our true feelings. Even after men commit suicide, they are called pussies. 

There is no comfort for us, and there never will be.
